analyzer_calibration.bound_proof: For uniform basis sampling and trusted projector calibration, |Tr rho(Cpert-C)|<=||Cpert-C||_op. If basis efficiency lies in [eta_min,eta_max] independent of the outcome, the postselected average is <=eta_max/eta_min times the calibrated uniform upper bound.
analyzer_calibration.scope: Declared synthetic 4-mode perturbations and efficiency band only; not measured error or physical engineering loss budgets.

detector_to_W33_carrier.mapping: Each (basis, source slot, wrong destination slot) maps bijectively to one oriented 40-ray W33 graph edge. Every orthogonal ray pair belongs to one tetrad.
detector_to_W33_carrier.physical_interface_limit: A detector slot substitution is a classical event edge in W33, not a physical two-qutrit Pauli operator. The selected H27-CSS code has a distinct 27-vertex/135-edge Schlaefli chain complex; no equivariant chain map, qutrit encoder, or fault-tolerant recovery is established.

finite_key.finite_key_warning: No composable finite-key entropy bound follows solely from the Witting matching witness; parameter estimation and smooth min-entropy vs coherent attacks remain unproved.
finite_key.one_way_hashing_rate: R_hash= max(0, 2 - S(rho_v)) bits per two-ququart copy under trusted isotropic-state and asymptotic one-way hashing assumptions

product_state_postselection_attack.loophole: If a detector or public basis announcement allows setting-dependent acceptance and calibration does not constrain it, a separable product state achieves 100% matches on 10% accepted bases. This invalidates an unqualified 40% postselected test.
product_state_postselection_attack.source: Separable state rho = |ray0><ray0|_A tensor |conj(ray0)><conj(ray0)|_B; four of forty Witting bases contain ray0.
